L01_female.wav.speaker: female
L01_female.wav.text: Hey Ken, do you want to go hiking this Saturday?

L02_male.wav.speaker: male
L02_male.wav.text: That sounds great, but can we meet early in the morning?

L03_female.wav.speaker: female
L03_female.wav.text: Sure, we can take a train to Mount Takao around eight.

L04_male.wav.speaker: male
L04_male.wav.text: Let us meet in front of the central ticket gate then.

L05_female.wav.speaker: female
L05_female.wav.text: Perfect, and what should we bring for lunch and snacks?

L06_male.wav.speaker: male
L06_male.wav.text: I can buy some sandwiches and bottles of cold green tea.

L07_female.wav.speaker: female
L07_female.wav.text: Thanks, and do not forget to bring a light rain jacket.

L08_male.wav.speaker: male
L08_male.wav.text: Got it, I will check the weather forecast tonight.
